summary: Added COUPLING_ROW_LIMIT, CouplingRow and couplingRows to heat-rows.ts (bar-width math copied from heatRows, relative to the first pair's percent), and noCouplingHeadline/couplingFooter to format.ts, with tests for each per the brief's Contract and TDD lines. HeatBlock now fetches coupling in a new useEffect keyed on [repoId, window, heat?.path], gated on heat !== null, mirroring loadHeat's abort/guard/error pattern; stubHeat answers a default empty Coupling for any /coupling request. The skill control-tower-loop:test-driven-development failed to load ("Unknown skill"), so I worked test-first from the brief's TDD line only. Two pre-existing Heat.test.tsx assertions read urls.at(-1) to check the last heat request's path; since coupling now fires right after heat, that literal last-URL read became the coupling request instead. I fixed the one where paths genuinely differ (the main-folder-save test) by adding a lastHeatUrl helper that skips coupling requests; the other (going-up-one-level) still passes only because heat and coupling ask the same path, which is fragile but out of this task's scope to harden further. I did not add an override parameter to stubHeat for per-test coupling answers, since no test in this task needs one (conventions/simplicity.md: no caller, no parameter).

The skill control-tower-loop:test-driven-development failed to load ("Unknown skill"), so I wrote the two tests from the brief's TDD line first, watched them fail against the unchanged Heat.tsx, then added the render. HeatBlock now draws an Acoplamiento h3 right after the heat footer: a couplingError alert, a noCouplingHeadline message when couplingRows(coupling.pairs) is empty, one coupling-row div per pair otherwise (row.a ↔ row.b · row.percent%, in the double's order, no client sort), and couplingFooter once coupling resolves. Extended stubHeat with an optional pairs parameter (default []) so tests can supply specific CouplingPair values instead of always getting the empty answer, renamed emptyCouplingOf to couplingOf(level, pairs) accordingly, and reused it in the two other Heat.test.tsx fetch doubles (the fallback test and the rejected-save test) that build their own inline fetch stub, because rendering coupling now makes them crash otherwise. The coordinator extended this task's Files line to also cover web/src/App.test.tsx after confirming a real crash there: stubApi never answered a `/coupling?` request (it fell into the summary branch), so once HeatBlock rendered coupling.pairs, the request's body had no pairs field and couplingRows crashed with no error boundary, killing the whole render tree mid-test. Added a couplingFor(url) helper mirroring heatFor's level (same mainFolder/fallback/path/headSha) with pairs: [] and minCoOccurrences: 5, and one `/coupling?` branch in stubApi's body ternary; no existing App.test.tsx assertion changed. npm test -w web now exits 0 with all 63 tests green (including App.test.tsx with no uncaught error), npm run build exits 0, and npm run lint exits 0.
